description: Pre-submission audit: metadata, screenshots, build, price, contact, products, and whether the support, privacy and terms links actually load. With project_path, also privacy manifests, required-reason APIs, listed SDKs and purpose strings, read locally. Every rule ends in PASS, WARN, FAIL or UNKNOWN, and any UNKNOWN withholds the clean verdict; project files are checked only with project_path. Fix each FAIL with the tool it names, then re-run. Pro feature.

platform.description: Audit one platform. Default: every platform with a version in progress.

project_path.description: Local folder of the app's Xcode project. Optional. Read only, nothing from it is executed or sent anywhere. Omit to audit the App Store Connect record alone.

name: release_preflight
title: Audit a version before submission
